stage0096_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$大統領$$
「Today, in this place, I will explain to you all
　about the unprecedented spacetime disaster now
　called the $$エタニティ・フラット$$.」

stage0096_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$大統領$$
「At the same time, you will also learn of a
　being that should be called humanity's
　natural enemy... the space life-form $$バアル$$.」

stage0096_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$大統領$$
「The $$エタニティ・フラット$$ and $$バアル$$...
　Both are a great calamity to us,
　and we are compelled to face them.」

stage0096_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$大統領$$
「And, at this very moment...
　in space, the asteroid $$アクシズ$$ is
　about to begin its fall toward Earth.」

stage0096_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$大統領$$
「The Earth Federation Forces are doing
　everything they can to stop $$アクシズ$$'s
　fall, but the situation allows no room for optimism.」

stage0096_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$大統領$$
「I appeal to all people living in this world.」

stage0096_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$大統領$$
「Please listen to this announcement with
　reason, and let each of you choose your
　own future. That is the duty of all who live in this world.」

stage0096_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$大統領$$
「Please listen to this announcement with
　reason, and let each of you choose your
　own future. That is the duty of all who live in this world.」

stage0096_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
Master
「Care for some coffee?
　It's on me.」

stage0096_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「Thank you very much.
　...I'll have some.」

stage0096_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
Master
「Don't see your face around here.
　Traveling alone? Where do you hail from?」

stage0096_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
Master
「A Spacenoid, huh...
　No wonder I don't recognize you.」

stage0096_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
Master
「Still, I don't much want to look up at
　the sky right now. Watching a huge chunk
　of rock fall from below isn't a good feeling.」

stage0096_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
Master
「There's also the $$エタニティ・フラット$$
　and $$バアル$$ the President's talking about.」

stage0096_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
Master
「No matter where you run on Earth...
　or even out to space, you can't outrun
　what you hate. That's always been true.」

stage0096_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
Master
「I'll think about what to do next once
　the President's finished talking.
　Assuming this $$アクシズ$$ doesn't fall on us.」

stage0096_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「...Have you lived in this place all along?」

stage0096_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
Master
「Yeah...
　We were just talking about running,
　but I can't leave now, not after all this time.」

stage0096_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
Master
「I'm a man of the $$ＵＣＷ$$, but my
　generation grew up hearing our
　grandparents tell of the old horrors. Sounds awful.」

stage0096_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
Master
「Wanting to do something about it,
　people formed the Federation and started
　space emigration. Long before the $$大時空震動$$.」

stage0096_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
Master
「Some say only the poor were forced out
　into space, but plenty of others left
　by their own choice too.」

stage0096_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
Master
「Resolved not to return until Earth's
　nature recovered. Though the $$一年戦争$$
　and the fighting after it undid most of that...」

stage0096_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「...There's no relief in that, is there.」

stage0096_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
Master
「Well, it can't be helped.
　It all started from good intentions.」

stage0096_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
Master
「Both the Federation and emigration started
　from the good intention of wanting to
　save mankind.」

stage0096_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
Master
「Same as wanting to make your company
　profit, or wanting to give your family a better life.」

stage0096_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「But that... can all too easily become
　something you'd have to call ego.」

stage0096_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
Master
「Maybe so...
　But deny that, and this world is
　nothing but darkness.」

stage0096_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
Master
「I'm sure there are people who can deny
　themselves and work for the greater
　good, but that's suspicious in its own way.」

stage0096_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
Master
「Like Neo Zeon's $$シャア$$, for one.
　Says it's all for the people's sake,
　then drops meteors on them...」

stage0096_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
Master
「Maybe the truth is he's never actually
　liked humanity. That's why he can do
　something like this without blinking.」

stage0096_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「...I don't think he's doing it without a care.」

stage0096_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
Master
「Oh, my mistake. No bad-mouthing
　$$シャア・アズナブル$$ in front of
　a Spacenoid young lady.」

stage0096_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「No...
　What you said gave me something
　to think about too.」

stage0096_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「Besides, I have... no intention of
　approving of a method like dropping
　$$アクシズ$$, either.」

stage0096_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「But what should Earth do from here...?
　The $$エタニティ・フラット$$ and $$バアル$$...
　Both are far too great an obstacle.」

stage0096_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
Master
「Who knows...
　The President's speech is still going.
　There's a bit more time to think it over.」

stage0096_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
Master
「...Maybe that's all my generation's
　ever done, really. Just put off solving
　the problem, again and again...」

stage0096_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
Master
「I thought I was doing my best, but in
　the end I only put off the bill, living
　with regret that I left you all nothing...」

stage0096_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
Master
「The most I can do is brew you that coffee.」

stage0096_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「Because people can only do what they're able to do.」

stage0096_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
Master
「Hearing you say that eases my mind
　a little. ...Are you heading out?」

stage0096_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「Yes...
　To tell the truth, I was running from
　somewhere, and I ended up here.」

stage0096_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「But with the President, and everyone
　fighting beyond the sky, all doing everything
　they can, I've decided I want to do the same.」

stage0096_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
Master
「I think that's a good thing.」

stage0096_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ミネバ$$
「Let me ask you one last thing.
　Faced with that falling $$アクシズ$$,
　what do you wish for?」

stage0096_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
Master
「A wish upon a star... though that's an
　awfully dangerous shooting star.
　Let's see...」

stage0096_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
Master
「I wish for the future. A future
　overflowing with hope, equal for all.」

stage0096_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ミネバ$$
（$$シャア$$, $$ハマーン$$... $c, $$バナージ$$...
　I wish for the future too.）

stage0096_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$大統領$$
「...I have told you everything I know
　about the $$エタニティ・フラット$$ and $$バアル$$.」

stage0096_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$大統領$$
「From here, it is each and every one
　of you who will decide the shape of the world.」

stage0096_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「Those of you on Earth, please look up
　at the sky. Those of you in space,
　please look toward Earth.」

stage0096_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「Right now, where Earth and space meet,
　there are people fighting desperately
　to protect the world.」

stage0096_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$マリナ$$
「Please make a wish.
　For the future you hope for.」

stage0096_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ナナリー$$
「Each person's feelings create the future.
　Please pray for yourself, for those dear
　to you... and for the world.」

stage0096_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$リリーナ$$
「Those feelings will surely reach them.」

stage0096_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ラクス$$
「Let us pray, everyone.
　Not leaving everything to the heavens,
　but for the future we ourselves wish for...!」

stage0096_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ラクス$$
（$$アスラン$$, $$ルナマリア$$... please.）

stage0096_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ローナン$$
「What do you wish for, $$ミネバ$$ Zabi?」

stage0096_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ミネバ$$
（$$バナージ$$... everyone of $c...
　I wish for a boundless future.）

stage0096_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$レディ$$
「What is it that you wish for?」

stage0096_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$マリーメイア$$
「Not a false peace handed to us by
　someone else, but a peace we've won
　by our own strength, that's what I wish for.」

stage0096_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$沙慈$$
「What this world needs is hope for the future.」

stage0096_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$シェリル$$
「For a future overflowing with light!」

stage0096_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$シェリル$$
（A future where I walk on with someone
　precious to me... Go and win it, $$アルト$$.）

stage0096_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$シェリル$$
（For the world's future... and for you.）

stage0096_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ドナール$$
「I believe in you, all of you!」

stage0096_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$学園長$$
「May you all bring a future to this world!」

stage0096_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$スオミ$$
「We pray.
　For a world overflowing with love!」

stage0096_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ローレライ$$
「I believe in you!
　That all of you will win, no matter what enemy comes!」

stage0096_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ケンスケ$$
「I don't want $$バアル$$ either,
　but staying 14 forever is even worse!」

stage0096_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$扇$$
「We wish for a future!
　A future overflowing with possibility!」

stage0096_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$扇$$
「My child's about to be born!
　I won't accept a frozen, unmoving time!!」

stage0096_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$エンジェル$$
（That's right...
　Because there's a future, people can forget the past）

stage0096_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$エンジェル$$
（I chose a future.
　$$ロジャー$$... because you taught me hope）

stage0096_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$リーロン$$
「Our future is overflowing with possibility!
　Ever since that day... since we came up to the surface!」

stage0096_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ロシウ$$
「And ever since the Prison of Time was destroyed...」

stage0096_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Our true battle begins.」

stage0096_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$冬月$$
「What do you make of it?」

stage0096_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「What we do doesn't change.」

stage0096_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$冬月$$
「Then I suppose there's no harm
　in wishing for the future irresponsibly.」

stage0096_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「The future is something we create with our own hands.」

stage0096_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「If I were to pray for anything,
　it'd be that the children are safe.」

stage0096_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Whoaaa!
　Prison of Time, just disappear already!!」

stage0096_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$詩織$$
「Being stuck as a high school sophomore forever, no thank you!!」

stage0096_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$風間$$
「Ah... but everyone in the Volunteer Club
　might stay sophomores too...」

stage0096_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$風間$$
「Apparently it's become an issue in the staff room lately,
　that they've been skipping school too much」

stage0096_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「So they're... held back a year!?」

stage0096_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$恭子$$
「Yeah...!
　And they've been working so hard on their service activities!」

stage0096_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$風間$$
「Let's pray for everyone in the Volunteer Club too」

stage0096_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$詩織$$
「I wonder if that's okay...
　Isn't this... deciding the future of the world?」

stage0096_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Who cares!?
　Let's pray for their future too!」

stage0096_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$恭子$$
「May a bright future await
　everyone in the Volunteer Club too!!」

stage0096_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「It's pointless, $c.
　$$アクシズ$$ is going to fall.」

stage0096_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$シン$$
「You'll never know that until you try!」

stage0096_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Do your best, $$ガンバスター$$!
　Push it back with guts and effort!!」

stage0096_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$葵$$
「Let's... do this... yeah...!
　I'm doing this... I'm really doing this!!」

stage0096_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Do it, $$號$$!!
　Bring out the power of the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$!」

stage0096_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$甲児$$
「This is $$ゼウス$$'s golden right arm!
　I'll definitely push it back!!」

stage0096_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$シャア$$
「Just hold on a little longer!」

stage0096_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$.
　I knew you were planning to drop $$アクシズ$$
　today, for the sake of $$時空修復$$.」

stage0096_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「But I don't agree with something like that.
　Unless the will of the singularities aligns, $$時空修復$$ won't be possible.」

stage0096_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Why can you talk about it
　as if it's someone else's problem!」

stage0096_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「At this rate, you'll get caught up
　in $$アクシズ$$'s fall and die too!」

stage0096_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「I have no interest in my own life or death.」

stage0096_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「This man... does he carry the same nothingness as Schneizel!?」

stage0096_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$キラ$$
「You're someone who doesn't understand the meaning of life.」

stage0096_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Say what you like.
　Once $$アクシズ$$ falls, the world will move in the right direction.」

stage0096_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「And so, the Red Comet fades into history...
　I suppose my role ends here too.」

stage0096_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「This is... $$シャア$$'s consciousness, flowing into me!」

stage0096_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$シャア$$
「Lucky that we were both riding machines
　equipped with Psycoframe!」

stage0096_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「Are you trying to suppress my consciousness, $$シャア$$!?」

stage0096_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「And then, you'll repair spacetime into the world you want!?」

stage0096_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$シャア$$
「You and I are nothing more than vessels that gather people's will!
　It's everyone living in this world who decides the future!」

stage0096_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$トライア$$
「Can you hear me, Mr. Red Comet?」

stage0096_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$トライア$$
「OK.
　Somehow made it in time.」

stage0096_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$アスラン$$
「This is $$アスラン・ザラ$$.
　GN particle dispersal is complete,
　via the GN Drive provided by Celestial Being.」

stage0096_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ルナマリア$$
「This basically connects every colony
　with GN particles now!」

stage0096_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$イザーク$$
「The rest is up to you two!」

stage0096_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$キラ$$
「I'll do it! $$イザーク$$, $$ディアッカ$$!」

stage0096_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$トライア$$
「Federation, Zeon, none of that matters.
　We gave it everything to save the world too.」

stage0096_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$トライア$$
「On the ground, GN particle dispersal is complete too,
　thanks to $$ミスリル$$'s help.」

stage0096_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「You're connecting everyone's consciousness with GN particles!?」

stage0096_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「That's reckless...!
　Even GN particles have their limits!」

stage0096_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$トライア$$
「I made use of a few things to make up for that.」

stage0096_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$トライア$$
「You know it too, don't you, ladies' man?
　That there's something else that connects people's minds.」

stage0096_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$トライア$$
「That's right!
　Using that thing Secretary $$三島$$ of the Frontier fleet provided,
　I set up a relay station to link the GN particles.」

stage0096_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Correct!
　Threatened by that Doctor Fox,
　I released a huge burst of the Z-Chips I'd been saving up too!」

stage0096_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$トライア$$
「That's basically ultra-high-purity 《$$ＤＥＣ$$》.
　If we place it in key spots, we can create a field
　of mental wavelengths covering the whole Earth.」

stage0096_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$トライア$$
「The will of everyone gathered through GN particles,
　Fold Quartz and Z-Chips, I'll send to you all through this.」

stage0096_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$トライア$$
「This thing's a mass of $$ＤＥＣ$$, after all.
　It acts as an amp to amplify people's will.」

stage0096_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$トライア$$
「Plus, conveniently, it was already placed
　to cover the whole world.
　So now we can pick up every will on Earth too.」

stage0096_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$タケル$$
「Is that really okay!?
　Isn't $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ supposed to turn the Earth
　into a dead wasteland if we're not careful!」

stage0096_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$トライア$$
「Don't you worry.
　This is only acting as an amp and speaker.
　It's not draining any $$次元力$$.」

stage0096_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$バサラ$$
「Yeah, yeah!
　I'm feeling it now!!」

stage0096_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$トライア$$
「Now I'll gather everyone's will I've collected
　at the Great Singularity!」

stage0096_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$刹那$$
「I know!
　I'll use Quantum Burst!!」

stage0096_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$アルト$$! Activate the Fold Wave System!
　$$バナージ$$, $$カミーユ$$!
　Follow me!」

stage0096_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$アルト$$
（I can feel it...!
　$$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$'s song...!）

stage0096_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$アルト$$
（You two are singing
　for the sake of $$時空修復$$ too, aren't you...!）

stage0096_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$バナージ$$
「But...!
　In a situation like this, the unit's controls are...!」

stage0096_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$アマタ$$
「$$バナージ$$!
　Grab onto the EVOL's arm!
　I'll brace the Unicorn with the Mugen Attack!」

stage0096_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$カミーユ$$, grab onto the $$ガンバスター$$!」

stage0096_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I'll make a wall with EVA's A.T. Field!
　We should be able to move while it holds!」

stage0096_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'll activate the Lambda Driver too!」

stage0096_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$n
「I understand!
　I'll push $$ジェニオン$$'s D-Fault to full output too!」

stage0096_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'll use $$蜃気楼$$'s Druid System to analyze the situation
　and calculate the optimal route!」

stage0096_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$ゼロ$$, send me that data too.
　Combine your calculations with the Zero System's predictions,
　and the accuracy should improve even more.」

stage0096_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Look!
　Even the Neo Zeon mobile suits
　are trying to hold up $$アクシズ$$!」

stage0096_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But, with their machines, this is as far as it goes...」

stage0096_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
Neo Zeon Soldier
「It's whether the Earth is doomed or not!」

stage0096_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
Neo Zeon Soldier
「It's worth a try!」

stage0096_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
Neo Zeon Soldier
「Heh... ignoring what you did yourself
　and saying that ain't fair, Supreme Commander.」

stage0096_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
Neo Zeon Soldier
「Now we understand what you were trying to do, Supreme Commander!
　So...!」

stage0096_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「If you're going to apologize,
　you shouldn't have done it this way from the start!」

stage0096_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$ギュネイ$$
「Of course!
　Stopping the Supreme Commander's recklessness is my job!」

stage0096_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Everyone's hearts are gathering at $$アクシズ$$...」

stage0096_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$カミーユ$$, $$バナージ$$!
　Connect $$シャア$$ and $$フロンタル$$'s units
　to our Gundams!」

stage0096_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$アムロ$$
「We'll back up $$シャア$$ with our Psycho Wave!」

stage0096_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I feel it...
　So this is the will of everyone...」

stage0096_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$シャア$$
「Strange...
　Despite the situation, I feel no fear.
　If anything, it's warm. To feel reassured, of all things...」

stage0096_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$フロンタル$$
「But humans, holding this warmth,
　can't master their emotions and walk the path to ruin...!
　So a leader is needed to guide them to a better world!」

stage0096_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I know!
　That's why we have to show the world
　the light of people's hearts!」

stage0096_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「The light of people's hearts...」

stage0096_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$シャア$$
「Feel it, $$フル・フロンタル$$!
　This is the light of people's hearts... the power to hope for the future!」

stage0096_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$シャア$$
「$$ララァ$$!
　Guide me... guide the world!!」

stage0096_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As expected, this is a beautiful light...」

stage0096_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Whoops!
　How careless of me, forgetting my duties
　and getting lost in the sight without meaning to.」

stage0096_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, with that being the case,
　the celebration for the ace pilot will have to wait for another time...」

stage0096_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then!
　Even at a time like this, I'll stay fired up... business, business!」
